newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's San Paolo launches ethical funds.
newsitem.headline: Italy's San Paolo launches ethical funds.

text.p: Italy's largest banking group San Paolo di Torino is launching three ethical funds for investors in foreign and Italian bonds and foreign stocks.
San Paolo said in a statement its Sanpaolo Fondi fund management arm would start the three ethical funds, which it said were the first organised in Italy, from June 2.

The funds would be managed according to investment policies "marked by ethical principles in selecting issuers" including, in the case of governments, that of safeguarding human rights and in the case of individual firms their approach to protecting the environment.
San Paolo said it would also give financial support to humanitarian initiatives with part of its own sales from the ethical fund products.
